title: Leaked Mass Effect: Universe trailer gives a taste of what we're all missing
gist: A day after EA shut down BioWare and cancelled the next Mass Effect game, an internal roughly two-minute pre-production trailer for Mass Effect: Universe leaked on Reddit. IGN and Bloomberg's Jason Schreier confirmed it came from inside EA. EA executives said only a small team was in early development. Kyle Orland expects EA's new private owners to favor more profitable franchises such as Battlefield, The Sims and annual sports games over a big narrative RPG, while the Prime Video Mass Effect series continues.

themes.theme: BioWare closure and Mass Effect cancellation

insights.claim: In a staff memo, EA executives Cam Weber and David Tinson said only "a small team at BioWare" was in early development on the next Mass Effect, even though the game was teased in 2020. They said the decision not to move forward with it led to BioWare's closure.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: EA is cutting long-running projects that don't make money, a sign of portfolio pruning focused on margins.

insights.claim: Kyle Orland argues that fans petitioning EA to keep funding Mass Effect or license it out face an uphill battle. He expects EA's new private ownership to prioritize more profitable franchises like Battlefield, The Sims and annual sports releases over a large narrative action RPG. The petition has nearly 17,500 signatures.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Under private ownership, EA's capital is going to its proven live-service and sports franchises; a negative signal for AAA single-player RPG investment.
